name: Preparatory Physics Course - II
description: This is the second preparatory course in physics, building on Preparatory Course in Physics I. It covers electricity and magnetism: electrostatics and Gauss's law, capacitance, current electricity and circuits, magnetostatics, electromagnetic induction and AC/DC circuits, and electromagnetic waves; optics: reflection, refraction, dispersion, lenses and mirrors, and wave optics (interference); and modern physics: radioactivity, nuclear binding energy, fission and fusion, the photoelectric effect, Bohr's atomic model, X-rays and de Broglie matter waves. Emphasis is on building conceptual understanding and quantitative problem-solving skills for undergraduate engineering and science coursework.
